entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A Gothic horror plane where the humans are losing and devils swarm during Dark Ascension.

entities.name: Devils
entities.description: Three-to-four-foot, red-skinned, needle-toothed, horned and tailed creatures that crawled out of the sulfur-choked basement of Innistrad and sabotage and incite violence.

entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Powerful evil beings who employ devils and tempt mortals to give up what is most precious to them.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: Holy warriors of Innistrad who kill devils on sight despite diminished holy powers.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker with a greataxe and claw gauntlet.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker of battle and physical bravery who joins the combat himself.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker used as an example of a spell-focused fighter.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker used as an example of a spell-focused fighter.

events.summary: Devils swarm out of the crevices of Innistrad as Dark Ascension sweeps the plane.
events.quote: devils swarm out of the crevices of the plane, their shrill laughter heard in every village

events.summary: Priests and cathars kill devils on sight, knowing they herald ruin.
events.quote: Priests and cathars have taken to killing them on sight whenever possible

relations.note: Devils often work in the employ of demons, stirring up chaos.
relations.quote: Devils often work in the employ of demons, stirring up chaos and woe.
Priests and cathars have taken to killing them on sight whenever possible

relations.note: Devils crawled out of the basement of Innistrad.
relations.quote: a race of malevolent beings that crawled out of the sulfur-choked basement of the world
